marks.gloss_en: דתניא: עם הארץ שקיבל עליו דברי חבירות ונחשד לדבר אחד נחשד לכל התורה כולה, דברי רבי מאיר -- the proof that R' Meir holds suspect-on-one, suspect-on-all (kind tanya_kevatei for a bare דתניא; header)
an am haaretz who accepted upon himself the duties of a chaver and was suspected regarding one matter is suspected regarding the entire Torah -- R' Meir
a convert who accepted upon himself the words of Torah, even if suspected regarding one matter, is suspect regarding the entire Torah
one who comes to accept the duties of a chaver except for one matter is not accepted
and so a Levite who comes to accept the duties of Levites, and a priest who comes to accept the duties of priesthood, except for one matter, is not accepted
one who comes to accept the duties of a chaver: if we saw him conduct himself privately within his house, he is accepted and afterwards taught
אם כן, הוה ליה מקולי בית שמאי ומחומרי בית הלל -- if so, this would be one of the leniencies of Beit Shammai and stringencies of Beit Hillel
אלא בית הלל אומרים: אחד זה ואחד זה לשלשים -- the baraita is emended: Beit Hillel say thirty days for both
the stam: rather [read the baraita]: Beit Hillel say, both this and that -- thirty [days]
Beit Shammai: for liquids [he is accepted after] thirty days
לפי שאינו דומה חבר שקיבל לבן חבר שקיבל -- RSBG's own ground
one who comes to accept the matters of chaverut must accept before three chaverim
a chaver who died -- his wife, his children and the members of his household remain in their presumption until they are suspected
the wife of an am ha'aretz who marries a chaver must accept divrei chaverut from the outset
R' Meir: they too -- the wife of a chaver who married an am ha'aretz -- must accept divrei chaverut from the outset
they accept [him] for wings, and afterwards they accept [him] for pure items
שכבר קיבל עליו משעה שישב -- the first tanna's ground for the elder's exemption
one who comes to accept the matters of chaverut must accept before three chaverim
R' Yochanan: this mishna was taught in the days of the son of R' Chanina ben Antigonus
R' Yehuda: this one's father degraded Torah scholars, and he too degrades Torah scholars
R' Yosei: let the elder's honour rest in its place; rather, from the day the Temple was destroyed the priests adopted a higher standard for themselves, that they do not hand taharot to every person
